title: Project Structural Record
description: Structural Project graph node. Project type, capacity, dates, construction state, and operating characteristics belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Project graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Project contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary project name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label for navigation; never a sourced project name.

company_id.description: Structural edge to the Company node responsible for organizing this Project.

campus_id.description: Structural edge to the Campus node containing this Project.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not project construction or operating status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted business facts.
